# Standard input is formatted with no package, even in a package
# directory: an editor pipes a buffer from wherever it runs, often the
# module root, so the package there is not the buffer's. The layout's
# <style> element, which would make .x block, does not apply, and the
# span is left as written.

stdin page.gohtml
muxt fmt
cmp stdout page.gohtml

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- m.go --
package m

import "embed"

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templates embed.FS
-- layout.gohtml --
<style>.x{display:block}</style>
-- page.gohtml --
<p>a<span class="x">b</span> c</p>
